d:
Chhath mahaparv sirph bihar aur purvanchal tak simit nahin raha, balki aaj iski charcha puri duniya men ho rahi hai. bihar ki mitti se nikli lok aastha aur sury upasna ki yah anokhi paranpra ab landan samet duniya ke kaee deshon tak pahunch chuki hai. samjhie kahani
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
